item.title: Filtronic shares dip as profit falls
item.summary: Filtronic reported a sharp fall in annual profit as it ploughed money into new capacity and technology, though the RF specialist held revenue broadly flat, diversified its customer base and entered the new year with most of its 2027 sales already covered. Revenue for the 12 months to 31 May slipped to £55.5m from £56.3m, […] The post Filtronic shares dip as profit falls appeared first on UK Investor Magazine .
